extensions.name: kaltura
extensions.title: Kaltura Video
extensions.description: Embed and play Kaltura video inline on a Lucidspark board. Paste a Kaltura embed code.

settings.name: partnerId
settings.label: Kaltura Partner ID
settings.description: Your Kaltura account (Partner) ID. Find it in the KMC under Settings ▸ Integration Settings. Used as a fallback partner ID when a pasted player URL does not already contain one. Full embed codes are self-contained and do not need this.

settings.name: defaultPlayerId
settings.label: Default Player ID (uiConf ID)
settings.description: The default Kaltura player / uiConf ID to use when a pasted player URL does not specify one. Find player IDs in the KMC under Studio.

settings.name: playerDomain
settings.label: Player CDN Domain (optional)
settings.description: The Kaltura player CDN host to embed from. Leave blank to use the default (cdnapisec.kaltura.com).
